ROOKSTRIDE / Experimental alpha

A useful first app. A careful next chapter.

Android works today. Browser, iPhone and messenger tools need their own implementation and checks. These plans are not download promises.

Download Android APKStart

Languages first

English, Russian, Persian, Arabic and Simplified Chinese cover the first practical flows. Flexible layout, right-to-left support and shared catalogs make later updates reviewable.

Available in the Android app

Browser planner and native handoff

First, help choose a recipe and open the native installer without putting passwords in the plan. Ordinary browsers and PWAs cannot open raw SSH connections.

Planned — not available yet

User-controlled web management

A later local companion or self-hosted connector could provide browser management. It needs authenticated HTTPS, SSH identity checks, bounded actions, durable jobs and a private credential boundary.

Planned — not available yet

iPhone administration and VPN

Research native SSH, Keychain storage, Apple VPN permissions and review requirements. Reuse recipe contracts; the Android VPN engine is not automatically an iPhone engine.

Planned — not available yet

Telegram assistant

A future bot or Mini App could guide onboarding and report approved status. Validate sessions and require explicit approval for changes. Root passwords and private keys must not be sent in chats.

Planned — not available yet

Weixin / WeChat

Evaluate the actual platform APIs, domain rules, account eligibility and review requirements before promising support. A status assistant is a separate gate from a VPN client or SSH installer.

Planned — not available yet

Every platform earns its own proof.

Verify server identity before credentials, keep protocol choices explicit, preserve reset review and fail-closed routing, and test interruption, recovery and real devices.
